visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair and a white low-cut ribbed tank top speaks excitedly to someone off-camera. She gestures with both hands near her head, showing high energy and animated facial expressions against a plain white wall. (2) The scene cuts to a second young woman with brown hair in a ponytail wearing a navy blue t-shirt. She is initially looking down at a pink smartphone but looks up with a suspicious and wide-eyed expression as she listens. (3) Returning to the first woman, she continues her narrative with intense hand gestures, leaning slightly forward. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting her facial features and the texture of her white top. (4) The woman in the blue shirt is shown again, staring straight ahead with an extremely tense and exaggerated wide-eyed look. She appears to be consciously trying to keep her eyes from drifting downwards while the first woman continues talking. (5) The second woman eventually glances down, then immediately reacts with a jerk, looking away and reaching for her hair. She appears flustered and embarrassed, with her mouth agape in an apologetic expression.
